summary: Iter57 (Saved Filter Views, Trip Export CSV/XLSX, Auth Failure Drill-Down, Save-Health Sparkline) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite for iter57 = 12/12 PASS. Frontend flows verified: saved-views CRUD & multi-company isolation, CSV/XLSX export with filter respect, Auth drill-down modal with PII safety, sparkline SVG. No regressions observed in Trip Log, Dashboard, Deploy Guard tile. Only issue found: pre-existing test_iter51_deploy_guard_and_alerts.py fails when invoked recursively via /api/admin/deploy-readiness (self-referential nested run) — passes 10/10 standalone. Unrelated to iter57.

minor.issue: test_iter51_deploy_guard_and_alerts.py fails ONLY when invoked recursively via the deploy-readiness endpoint (nested run). Iter51 itself invokes deploy-readiness in its own tests, causing DB/subprocess race. Standalone `pytest test_iter51...` = 10/10 PASS. iter57 12/12 PASS both standalone and inside deploy-readiness. Pre-existing flake, not iter57 regression.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate iter51 nested-invocation failure inside /api/admin/deploy-readiness (Regression Guard reports 'fail' even though iter57 passes). This appears to be a pre-existing self-referential race in test_iter51 — not caused by iter57.
critical_code_review_comments: PII Safety verified: /api/admin/save-health/auth-failures explicitly projects out `_id` and `ts`; middleware NEVER stores Authorization/Cookie/token/password. Table rows contain only ts_iso, method, path, status, latency_ms, kind, ip. Confirmed via both backend response inspection and DOM inspection of the drill-down modal — no leakage.
Multi-company isolation: saved_filters.py scopes list/create/delete by (user_id, company_id). Verified in backend test_saved_filter_company_isolation and by API contract review.

Export filter parity: _build_trip_filter_query is shared by /api/trips and /api/trips/export so export contents match the listing 1:1. Verified via CSV row count == X-Total-Count for the same filter (45 == 45 with q=Kondapalli).
Export cap at 10k rows — sensible; document to user if their date range >10k rows expected.
Sparkline endpoint properly clamps hours (≤168) and buckets (≤96). Uses aggregation pipeline; efficient.
Minor: 'top_ips' in auth-failures may reveal internal LB IP (127.0.0.1) — expected since ingress terminates locally; not a leak.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_bitumen_2026 (demo user). Frontend: demo-login-button on /login.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed data (9,382 trips, multiple companies).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter57 fully green. When testing regression via /api/admin/deploy-readiness, note that iter51 nested failure is a pre-existing self-referential issue (iter51 tests invoke deploy-readiness which then re-runs iter51). Use direct pytest of individual suites to bypass. iter57 backend tests are @ /app/backend/tests/test_iter57_saved_filters_export_drill_spark.py.
